requirements.requiredAuthority: None inside Maestro for the write-time hold (GT1-09-04) and the launch-time strip of credential and account names (GT1-09-04A). requirements.releaseImpact: A managed Grok launch no longer inherits GROK_AUTH, GROK_AUTH_PATH, XAI_API_KEY or GROK_HOME, and receives the approved account home. requirements.requirement: A Grok credential printed into a log line, an error or a support package is redacted by the one secret redactor whatever name it travels under.
requirements.surface: support package (logs.json, settings.json sweep), Send Feedback outbound text, every redactSecrets() caller
requirements.reason: Was: redactSecrets() knew no xAI key shape and GROK_AUTH carries no credential-shaped name, so `GROK_AUTH=xai-...`, a bare `xai-...` key in an error line and a `{"key":"xai-..."}` record reached the support package verbatim (found by the GT1-09-12 canaries). Fixed by GT1-09-12B: the one redactor now has an xai- provider key prefix rule (kind api_key, `xai-` and 20 or more alphanumeric characters, word-bounded, linear) beside sk-/rk-, so every caller (support package, Send Feedback, agent-run ledger, Computer History) redacts it.
requirements.requiredAuthority: None: fixed inside Maestro in src/shared/redactSecrets.ts.
requirements.releaseImpact: None for the shapes covered. A Grok credential in a shape other than an xai- key and under no credential-shaped name would still need a new rule.

progress.detail: redaction-canaries.test.ts flips the pinned gap: GROK_AUTH=xai-... and a bare xai- key are absent from logs.json in a real generateDebugPackage() write, replaced by [REDACTED_API_KEY]. redactSecrets.test.ts adds the GROK_AUTH, error-line and JSON-value shapes, non-key twins (xai-sdk, xai-grok-cli-integration-tests, xai-key, a 16-character run) left untouched, and two 64 KB ReDoS inputs. With the rule removed the four new key cases fail; the 22 redaction consumer suites otherwise match HEAD. No Grok bypass, no second redactor. GT1-09-13 executes the verification.
